caseName: Cline v. Okla. Coal. for Reprod. Justice
caseNameFull: Terry CLINE v. OKLAHOMA COALITION FOR REPRODUCTIVE JUSTICE

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Oklahoma granted. This Court, pursuant to the Revised Uniform Certification of Questions of Law Act, Okla. Stat., Tit. 20, § 1601 et seq. (West 2002), respectfully certifies to the Supreme Court of Oklahoma the following question: Whether H.B. No. 1970, Section 1, Chapter 216, O.S.L. 2011 prohibits: (1) the use of misoprostol to induce abortions, including the use of misoprostol in conjunction with mifepristone according to a protocol approved by the Food and Drug Administration; and (2) the use of methotrexate to treat eptopic pregnancies. Further proceedings in this case are reserved pending receipt of a response from the Supreme Court of Oklahoma.
